# GetHired

> GetHired (https://gethired.devhub.co.in) is an AI job search platform for every kind of role. Job seekers chat with an AI agent that searches thousands of openings across industries and matches them to their resume, tracks applications, emails job alerts, reviews their CV and runs mock interviews. Companies get an AI recruiter that drafts job posts, ranks matched candidates, screens applicants with AI interviews and runs a lightweight ATS.

Every page listed here has a markdown version: add `.md` to the URL (the home page is `/index.md`). The links below point to the markdown versions.

## Job seekers

- [Home](https://gethired.devhub.co.in/index.md): The AI job-search agent and what it does
- [AI job search agent](https://gethired.devhub.co.in/ai-job-search-agent.md): Search, match, apply, track and prepare in one chat, for any kind of role
- [Job application tracker](https://gethired.devhub.co.in/application-tracker.md): Saved jobs and applications from any site in one place
- [Job alerts](https://gethired.devhub.co.in/job-alerts.md): Daily or weekly emails with new jobs for a search
- [AI resume checker](https://gethired.devhub.co.in/ai-resume-checker.md): Resume feedback for a target role
- [AI interview practice](https://gethired.devhub.co.in/ai-interview.md): Mock interviews with feedback
- [Browse jobs](https://gethired.devhub.co.in/jobs): Current job listings, searchable by role, skill and location (HTML only)

## Companies

- [Hire talent](https://gethired.devhub.co.in/hire.md): The AI recruiter, candidate matching, screening and pipeline
- [AI recruiter agent](https://gethired.devhub.co.in/hire/ai-recruiter-agent.md): A chat assistant that drafts jobs, ranks candidates and moves your pipeline, with approvals
- [AI job description generator](https://gethired.devhub.co.in/hire/ai-job-description-generator.md): Draft a full job post and application questions from a short description
- [AI candidate matching](https://gethired.devhub.co.in/hire/ai-candidate-matching.md): Matched candidates with a 0 to 100 score and the reasons
- [Talent pool software](https://gethired.devhub.co.in/hire/talent-pool.md): Import resumes and spreadsheets and match them to new jobs
- [Candidate outreach](https://gethired.devhub.co.in/hire/candidate-outreach.md): Consent-based messages to matched candidates
- [AI applicant screening](https://gethired.devhub.co.in/hire/ai-applicant-screening.md): Fit scores, must-have checks and knockout rules for every application
- [AI screening interviews](https://gethired.devhub.co.in/hire/ai-screening-interviews.md): Structured voice interviews with one-page reports
- [Applicant tracking system](https://gethired.devhub.co.in/hire/applicant-tracking-system.md): Pipelines, board, notes, email templates and funnel for startups
- [Interview scheduling](https://gethired.devhub.co.in/hire/interview-scheduling.md): Interview plans, panels, self-scheduling links and scorecards
- [Careers page builder](https://gethired.devhub.co.in/hire/careers-page-builder.md): A branded careers page and custom application forms
- [Job multiposting](https://gethired.devhub.co.in/hire/job-multiposting.md): Google, Bing and job board distribution from one post
- [Hiring team collaboration](https://gethired.devhub.co.in/hire/hiring-team-collaboration.md): Roles, permissions, hiring teams and an audit log
- [Pricing for companies](https://gethired.devhub.co.in/pricing/companies.md): Plans, prices and what each includes

## Integrations

- [MCP server](https://gethired.devhub.co.in/mcp-server.md): Connect Claude to GetHired job search and resume tools
- [Introducing the GetHired MCP Server](https://gethired.devhub.co.in/blog/introducing-the-get-hired-mcp-server.md): What the MCP server does and how to set it up
- [Chrome extension](https://gethired.devhub.co.in/extension.md): Fills in job applications from your GetHired profile (coming soon)
